title: Spectrum DM26PB-Pro Petrol Leaf Blower — Lightweight & Anti-Vibration
description_html:
From autumn leaf-fall to grass clippings, hedge trimmings, sawdust and even light snow, the Spectrum DM26PB-Pro Petrol Leaf Blower clears it fast — and keeps working right through the year. Cordless-free and always ready, it's the go-anywhere blower for gardens where the debris never stops.

Powerful, all-season performance

A high-performance 26cc 1hp two-stroke air-cooled petrol engine drives a strong, focused stream of air that shifts stubborn wet leaves, matted clippings and general garden debris with ease — so you clear larger areas in far less time.

Lighter in the hand, easier on the arms

At just 4.15kg, the DM26PB-Pro is noticeably lighter than many petrol blowers in its class. The balanced design gives you confident control around borders, paths, patios and open lawn, while an advanced anti-vibration system soaks up the buzz through the handle to keep longer clearing sessions comfortable.

Full control, less fatigue

A variable-speed throttle lets you dial the airflow to the job — a gentle breeze for delicate borders or full power for heavy, stubborn debris. For bigger areas, the built-in throttle lock holds your chosen speed so you're not squeezing the trigger the whole time, cutting hand fatigue on extended jobs.

Three ways to blow

Two nozzles are supplied so you can match the airflow to the task:

  • Fan nozzle — a wide spread of air for quickly sweeping large areas like lawns, driveways and patios
  • Jet nozzle — a concentrated, high-velocity blast for moving heavy, wet or stubborn debris
  • Standard blower tube — remove the jet tip for everyday, general-purpose clearing

Backed by Spectrum's 5-year warranty

Like all premium Spectrum garden machinery, the DM26PB-Pro is covered by an extended 5-year manufacturer's warranty for complete peace of mind.*

*Terms & conditions apply. To maintain the extended warranty, the machine must be serviced annually from the beginning of year two. Domestic use only.

Key specifications

  • Engine: 26cc 1hp (0.75kW) two-stroke air-cooled petrol
  • Starting: recoil
  • Fuel tank: 0.5 litres
  • Air flow: 0.17m³/sec (10.2m³/hr)
  • Weight: 4.15kg
  • Supplied with: fan nozzle, jet nozzle and standard blower tube
  • Warranty: 5 years (T&Cs apply)
